checks.name: CRM confirmation persists explicit coupon definition and request idempotency
coupon right exists before real SMTP capture and accepted status reaches CRM
public clients cannot issue rights or impersonate a coupon owner
concurrent orders cannot consume a customer's coupon twice
accepted pre-dispatch cancellation restores the original right
checkout BFF verifies the coupon and replays the same confirmed order
stock failure releases the reserved coupon without a second use
API recovery completes an interrupted coupon settlement
temporary and persistent delivery failures use bounded retries
simulation and expired delivery never report SMTP acceptance
delivery survives a Notification service restart without duplicate SMTP messages
logistics tracks packing, courier location, dispatch and delivery with role restrictions
CRM history retains the customer's confirmed price snapshot
